What's new in EnigmaCast

EnigmaCast 1.0.0 is the first official release — no longer a beta. The app stays free.

• Turkish and Polish languages
• Programme description in the top info bar
• IPTV providers can be switched on or off per TV
• Faster background loading of channel lists and the guide
• Category navigation fix in IPTV Live TV
• You can now skip the receiver step in the setup wizard and use EnigmaCast as an IPTV player only; a receiver can be added later in Settings.

companion.notes: Live koppelt nu automatisch met de Enigma2-ontvanger van de TV. Nieuw: Zoeken en een Torrents-tab als die op de TV aanstaat.
